correctness.rationale: Every finite height-two incidence-algebra edge contributes two independent idempotent variables subject to at most one additional nonzero linear constraint for product idempotence. No steps rely on characteristic restrictions.

value.rationale: Product closure of idempotents is the defining issue for orthodox semigroups explicitly foregrounded by the primary literature. The complete joint rank refinement for arbitrary finite height-two posets goes beyond deciding orthodoxy, and the star family gives an exact all-q quantification with nontrivial \(3/4\) asymptotic, answering a natural random-product question.
